claim_title: SAE >=10x raw-neuron interpretable count per layer (target ~2548)

figures.caption: Per-layer estimated interpretable SAE features vs raw-neuron features (ESM-2-650M). Ratio SAE/neuron >=10x is MET at every non-L1 layer (8.0-19.3x); absolute target ~2548 (dashed line) is not hit at any layer - best is L9 at 1480 (main experiment) / 1430 (iter-2 rerun @ 3000 seqs x 300 features, 95% CI [1034, 1825]).
